subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) LR – QM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0e99d8fe4eab7f277f6a5bfb362278e919ab8d955aa51e6e6380734562d164c.png] 

Option 2) HN – MI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8d4e2ff2cf35cdaef41d853e808e2a70b2a7fefe43712625c5b4b229eb966c1.png] 

Option 3) WC – BY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22d40d26414437bb756288dbcecf5cb84097cefbf514a55bb8566b81c928eae1.png] 

Option 4) BH – GC

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ecf96ed3bd238addb04113acee26e4df68c60b0f48dcfd146035eb9a5db6217.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'WC – BY' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
